Delay (delay=k): first_entry_bar = signal_index + k, last_entry_bar = min(signal_index + entry_expiry_bars + k - 1, len-1) — giu nguyen do dai expiry (12 bars), holding_bars tinh tu entry thuc te nhu engine.
